verdicts.reason: A fills the tall format well, with a large bottle and a centred CTA. But the 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow has moved below the body copy, which breaks the original reading order. The text is left-aligned while the bottle and button are centred, the headline sits on the circle edge, and 'sparkling.' is left orphaned on its own line. B keeps the original order and a clean left edge. But it leaves roughly the bottom quarter of the canvas empty, the bottle is shrunk to a small accent jammed into the cropped circle at top right, and the CTA ends up floating mid-canvas, so the layout feels top-heavy and unfinished.
